narrative: The technology landscape is marked by significant AI advancements and growing pains, with financial cracks emerging in the AI spending boom and new ethical standards for data use, while cybersecurity remains a critical concern following a record-breaking crypto heist. Meanwhile, space technology sees both innovative AI applications, like Google's satellite AI server, and efforts to preserve iconic missions such as the Hubble Space Telescope.

highlights.title: Think you can save the Hubble Space Telescope? NASA wants to know.
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA is actively seeking commercial solutions to reboost and extend the operational life of the iconic Hubble Space Telescope, highlighting the increasing role of private sector in space maintenance.

highlights.title: Salesforce’s M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune
highlights.whyItMatters: This acquisition bolsters Salesforce's defense platform, signaling continued expansion of major tech companies into specialized and potentially sensitive sectors like AI logistics for defense.

highlights.title: Anthropic to receive high 'junk' rating from credit agencies following IPO
highlights.whyItMatters: This report indicates a growing financial scrutiny and skepticism towards the valuation and sustainability of even prominent AI companies post-IPO, reflecting broader market concerns about the AI boom.

highlights.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
highlights.whyItMatters: A significant supply chain attack affecting a prominent AI company's development tools highlights critical security vulnerabilities in the rapidly evolving AI software ecosystem.

highlights.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
highlights.whyItMatters: Major AI developers are collaborating on a standardized 'policy token' to allow publishers to control how their content is used for AI training, addressing a key ethical and copyright concern.

highlights.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
highlights.whyItMatters: This demonstrates a significant step in deploying AI processing capabilities directly in space, opening new possibilities for on-orbit data analysis and reducing latency for space-based applications.

highlights.title: Hackers steal $6.3 billion from Binance in record crypto heist
highlights.whyItMatters: This unprecedented cryptocurrency theft, allegedly linked to North Korean hackers, underscores persistent and evolving critical security vulnerabilities in the digital asset market.

highlights.title: Thousands of “ghost students” use AI to steal millions in student loans, DOJ says
highlights.whyItMatters: This highlights the negative societal impact of AI misuse, demonstrating a new vector for large-scale fraud facilitated by AI's capabilities in creating deceptive content and automating processes.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
topics.summary: The AI sector is experiencing a mix of innovation and caution, with Google launching an AI server in space and major players standardizing data scraping opt-outs. However, financial sustainability concerns are emerging, alongside critical security vulnerabilities in AI development tools, and new challenges from AI-driven fraud and ethical debates about its societal impact.

topics.name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection
topics.summary: The digital landscape remains under siege with a staggering $6.3 billion crypto heist from Binance highlighting financial security risks. Numerous cloud and application-level breaches, including those affecting Linode and Applebee's, alongside revelations of companies like GM selling customer data, underscore a persistent need for robust data protection across industries.

topics.name: Space Exploration & Infrastructure
topics.summary: NASA is actively seeking commercial proposals to reboost the venerable Hubble Space Telescope, while the industry sees a growing focus on in-space data processing with Google's satellite AI and Satlyt's efforts towards orbital data centers. Despite a looming launch crisis, advancements continue in observing the cosmos and understanding Mars.

topics.name: Hardware & Enterprise Technology
topics.summary: The hardware market faces shifts, exemplified by Intel's stock crash tied to PC sales dynamics, contrasting with Fujifilm's increased tape production driven by AI's archiving demands. Meanwhile, general cloud infrastructure continues to evolve with services like Cloudflare expanding, and smart home devices like Google's Nest thermostats remain popular.

topics.name: Autonomous Vehicles
topics.summary: The autonomous vehicle sector is making strides, with Waymo expanding its robotaxi deployment through a partnership with Toyota for Japan and the UK, while Rivian prepares for crucial tests of its hands-free driving technology.

notes: Several items pertaining to health news, cultural tributes, or niche developer tools were excluded to maintain focus on core editorial technology briefing themes.
Item counts for topics reflect conceptual groupings of closely related articles, even if listed separately in the original source list.
